column1: # Field batch: com.desertstormfront.config (115 fields: GameConfig 18, SubConfigDSF 34,
#  * UserConfig      - every field is written from, and stored back to, a named key of user.config
#                      (loadFromProperties / saveToProperties) AND is exposed by a getter renamed
#                      in the earlier UserConfig batch: property key + getter name = two sources.
#  * GameConfig      - every field is assigned in configure(...) and exposed by a semantic getter
#                      a/b/c are public statics without a getter:
#                        a = selects the "Clean" content variants (every branch it guards returns a
#                            this.m whose entries all carry "V01CleanETC"); set for the curated
#                        b = selects the per-game hidden data directory (".tropical_stormfront_")
#                            instead of ".config/<gameId>/". MEDIUM confidence: path style only.
#                        c = the Market, assigned from the market object in GameApplication.
#  * SubConfigDSF/TSF - the fields are constants; the overriding getters return the SAME literal
#                      inline (the obfuscator/decompiler duplicated them), so each field is matched
#                      to the getter whose return value is byte-identical to its initialiser.
#                      F (getMusicFiles). Pairs l/m, o/p, u/v, w/x, y/z are the plain and the
#                      "Clean" variant of the same text (see GameConfig.a above).
#                      f ("Real-Time Strategy") has no consuming getter - named from its content.
# Descriptors come from javap: do not edit them, the renamer matches on them.
